children: PepsiCo adds Johnson & Johnson Chairman and CEO Joaquin Duato to its board as an independent director, effective Dec. 1. Duato, 64, will serve on the Audit Committee. The appointment brings healthcare-sector experience to PepsiCo's governance, as Duato has spent more than three decades at J&J navigating highly regulated markets. PepsiCo Chairman and CEO Ramon Laguarta said Duato's background in strategic transformation and portfolio optimization will support the company as it evolves its product lineup and invests in growth opportunities across its global beverage and foods businesses.
